tools.name: list_games
tools.title: List games
tools.description: List all daily sports trivia games available on DoUKnowBall, optionally filtered by sport category.

tools.name: most_played_today
tools.title: Most played today
tools.description: Return the most-played DoUKnowBall games today (UTC), ranked by number of completions across all visitors.

limit.description: Maximum number of games to return. Defaults to 10. Clamped between 1 and 50.

tools.name: leaderboard_today
tools.title: Leaderboard for today
tools.description: Return the top scoring players for a given DoUKnowBall game today (UTC). Uses each player's best score for the day.

game.description: Game slug (path without leading slash), e.g. 'soccer-grid' or 'guess-transfer-value'.

limit.description: Number of leaderboard entries to return. Defaults to 25. Clamped between 1 and 100.
